bootleap can now print its report as JSON, for scripts and other tools.

### JSON output

```
java -jar bootleap.jar my-service --format json
```

```json
{
  "context": "Checking against Spring Boot 4.0 (found 4.0.10 in build.gradle:2).",
  "count": 1,
  "findings": [
    {"rule": "mock-bean", "file": "src/test/java/demo/OrderControllerTest.java", "line": 3, "problem": "@MockBean was removed in Spring Boot 4, so this test no longer compiles.", "fix": "Use @MockitoBean from org.springframework.test.context.bean.override.mockito (part of Spring Framework). ..."}
  ]
}
```

`line` is 0 when the finding is about the whole file. The exit codes did not change: `0` nothing found, `1` something found, `2` bad input.

### GitHub Action

Nothing changed in the action. To use this release, point it at the new tag:

```yaml
      - uses: JooaoGui/bootleap@v0.3.0
```

### Download

`bootleap.jar` below, Java 17 or later. `bootleap.jar.sha256` has the checksum.
